passive.name: Ringing Melody
passive.text: When a **Basic Attack** hits an enemy, gain 1 stack of **Tea-riffic**. Each stack of **Tea-riffic** increases the user's Impact by **0.7/0.88/1.05/1.22/1.4%**, stacking up to 30 times, and lasting for 8s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Upon acquiring **Tea-riffic**, if the equipper possesses stacks of **Tea-riffic** greater than or equal to 15, all squad members' DMG is increased by **20/23/26/29/32%** for 10s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Binding Chains
passive.text: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from **Basic Attacks** increase by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%** for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Thick Broth
passive.text: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by **2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2%**, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Behemoth Hunter
passive.text: When the target's HP is no lower than 50%, the equipper inflicts **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** more Daze to the target. When the target's HP is no lower than 75%, this bonus is further increased by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

substatLine: CRIT RATE > CRIT DMG > ATK% > PEN = ATK
skillPriority: Basic Attack > Special Attack > Chain Attack > Dodge > Assist

entries.name: Basic Attack: Penultimate
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing **Physical DMG** and **Electric DMG**.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press Basic Attack to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using **Dodge** during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's **Basic Attack** combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing Basic Attack to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Blossoms
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack to activate:
Launches a forward rush attack, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Flash Connect
entries.text: When Qingyi deals **Electric DMG** with a skill, she accumulates **Flash Connect Voltage**. When **Flash Connect Voltage** reaches 75%, she will enter the **Flash Connect** state. When using her **Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms**, Qingyi will consume all **Flash Connect Voltage** and exit the **Flash Connect** state. For every 1% of **Flash Connect Voltage** consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. **Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms** itself does not accumulate **Flash Connect Voltage**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms
entries.text:
During the **Flash Connect** state, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Launch five consecutive forward rush attacks, then execute a Finishing Move that inflicts massive **Electric DMG**. Release Basic Attack during the move to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Activate the Finishing Move just before the character is attacked to trigger **Perfect Dodge**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the rush attack. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

entries.name: Dodge: Swan Song
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Breach
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a Dodge to activate:
Rush forward and then launch an upward attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Lingering Sentiments
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Leap into the air and then perform a downward attack, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Leap into the air and perform a downward attack, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Graceful Embellishment
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of **Assist Points** when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Rush forward with an attack and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Sunlit Glory
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Quickly swings upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Moonlit Begonia
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Quickly swings upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of attacks, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Hold EX Special Attack to consume additional energy to increase the number of hits of the series of attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a **Basic Attack**.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Tranquil Serenade
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, dealing massive **Electric DMG**
When this attack hits an enemy, the skill's DMG increases by 3% for every stack of **Subjugation** in **Core Passive: Eternal Seasons** the target has.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Eight Sounds of Ganzhou
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Eternal Seasons
entries.text: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her **Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms**, it applies 5 stacks of **Subjugation** to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of **Subjugation** increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by **4**%. For each rush attack performed during **Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms**, the Finishing Move will apply an extra stack of **Subjugation**. If **Perfect Dodge** is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies 10 stacks of **Subjugation**. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of **Subjugation** are reset.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Three Verses of Farewell at Yang Pass
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Attack** character or shares the same Faction:
**Basic Attacks** deal 20% increased Daze. If Qingyi's Impact is greater than 120, each point over increases her ATK by 6, up to a maximum of 600.

entries.name: Insulation Breakdown
entries.text:
When Qingyi enters combat, **Flash Connect Voltage** is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%.
When using her **Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms**, if **Flash Connect Voltage** is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.

entries.name: Minimal Effort, Maximum Impact
entries.text:
The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of **Subjugation** in **Core Passive: Eternal Seasons** increases to 135% of its original value.
When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of **Subjugation** she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.

entries.name: Drink Hot Water
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Stable Arc Barrier
entries.text:
Upon entering or exiting **Flash Connect** state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP.
If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.

entries.name: Youthful Spirit
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Eight Meridians
entries.text:
The Interrupt Level of **Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms** is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%.
When Qingyi hits an enemy with her **Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms**, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.
